headline: Bipartisan US bill would require frontier AI safety frameworks
body: Two House members, Jay Obernolte and Lori Trahan, released a 269-page draft 'Great American AI Act'. It would require large frontier developers to publish safety frameworks, report critical incidents and undergo audits, while overriding state frontier-AI laws for three years; unions opposed it. Mandatory safety work strengthens Alignment & Control, lifting Protector God and Libertarian Utopia and pushing Conquerors down. Overriding state laws counts as a step back for Global Coordination. Nvidia also released an open-weight 550B model, Nemotron 3 Ultra, slightly spreading power. Protector God moved back above Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance rose 0.98 to 3.0.
movers_note: Conquerors -0.7, mostly from the Great American AI Act draft (-0.69). Protector God +0.7, from the Great American AI Act draft (+0.69), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Zookeeper -0.6, mostly from the Great American AI Act draft (-0.50) and Nvidia's open Nemotron 3 Ultra (-0.04).
